svg.title: Backends for Frontends (BFF)
svg.desc: Backends for Frontends (BFF). A dedicated backend per client type, shaped for exactly what that UI needs. Step 1, One API for every client: One API for both clients: web makes 3 round trips per page; mobile downloads 200 KB it barely uses. Step 2, A backend per experience: Split it: a Web BFF and a Mobile BFF, each owned and shipped by the team that builds that frontend. Step 3, Shape the response: Mobile BFF merges 3 calls into one 12 KB reply; Web BFF returns a richer page model, also in 1 trip. Step 4, No tokens in the browser: Web BFF signs in as a confidential client and keeps the tokens; the browser gets an HttpOnly cookie.

g.text: One API for both clients: web makes 3 round trips per page; mobile downloads 200 KB it barely uses.
Split it: a Web BFF and a Mobile BFF, each owned and shipped by the team that builds that frontend.
Mobile BFF merges 3 calls into one 12 KB reply; Web BFF returns a richer page model, also in 1 trip.
Web BFF signs in as a confidential client and keeps the tokens; the browser gets an HttpOnly cookie.

tiny mid sb f-amber-ink bff-w bff-rt2

g.text: BFF ships without an app release
Native apps are OAuth clients themselves (RFC 8252).
